title: Austin Leadership Goes Private
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened with all city leadership present.
*   The primary purpose was to immediately enter a closed, executive session.
*   This private discussion was authorized by specific state laws concerning confidential matters.
*   Any final actions or decisions resulting from the closed session would be made public later.
